headline: Linn Mercy and Fishermans Row Lines Stay Fluid
war_summary: Another Linn Mercy ownership shift was filed since the last dispatch; that map now shows ten Colonial posts to one Warden, with Rotdust and Lathair still the busiest named points. Fishermans Row likewise recorded a fresh turn, Fort Ember changing hands and leaving eight posts Colonial against one Warden. Weathered Expanse and Stonecradle have gone quiet on the ownership board: Weathered Expanse holds six Warden posts to three Colonial, Stonecradle six Colonial to three Warden, with no new base events in the past two hours but no shortage of casualties. Stlican Shelf continues at five Warden posts to four Colonial, and Callahan's Passage remains wholly Warden without a day-long recorded base event, though its casualty totals keep climbing. DeadLands, still entirely Colonial, has had no base event in six hours but shows sudden casualty acceleration. Mooring County keeps all twelve posts for the Wardens. No faction has yet declared victory.
